subject: Strategic Budget Priorities and Federal Fund Allocation
overview: The Committee reviewed FY22 budget proposals for elementary and secondary schools, focusing on pandemic recovery and strategic staffing. They approved motions to incorporate critical recommendations and COVID-19 mitigation strategies into the final budget request.

items.title: Budget Process and ESSER Strategy
items.summary: Director David Murphy explained the strategy for balancing federal ESSER funds against the operating budget while warning against creating long-term structural deficits.

items.title: Elementary School Priorities
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent Suzanne Galusi and Principal Kirk Johnson identified key needs including reading interventionists, grade-level paraprofessionals to support inclusion, and a new specials program targeting social-emotional learning.

items.title: Secondary School Priorities
items.summary: The Committee discussed secondary priorities including restoring middle school math and reading interventionists and expanding instructors for Chapter 74 vocational programs.

items.title: Budget Motions and COVID Mitigation
items.summary: Approved motions to include the superintendent's critical recommendations and COVID-19 mitigation priorities in the final budget proposal for final review later in the month.
